pages.title: Observability
pages.purpose: Index of observability infrastructure: logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerting, and quality gates.

page_notes.content: Canonical anchors: docs/00-project/RULES.md, docs/02-architecture/decisions/, src/bioetl/infrastructure/observability/, grafana/dashboards/.

page_notes: Current dashboards (2026-08): bioetl-control-plane-v1, bioetl-overview-v2, bioetl-runtime, bioetl-provider-health-v2, bioetl-dq-v2, bioetl-incident-v1, bioetl-run-explorer-v1. Retired: bioetl-workflow-overview, bioetl-alerts-slo, bioetl-silver-reject-explorer.
Infrastructure changes (2026-08): Loki, Promtail, Tempo, Quarantine Explorer UI removed; BioETL Ops HTTP datasource for identity panels; opt-in monitoring via make docker-start-monitoring.

pages.title: Logging
pages.purpose: Documents the UnifiedLogger, LogEvents enum, structured logging conventions, and the logger port abstraction.

pages.title: Metrics
pages.purpose: Covers Prometheus metrics, metric naming conventions, and the metrics port abstraction.

pages.title: Tracing
pages.purpose: Documents distributed tracing, span propagation, and the tracing port abstraction.

pages.title: Dashboards
pages.purpose: Index of Grafana dashboards, panel queries, and visualization conventions.
page_notes: Recent refactoring (2026-08): Run Explorer simplification (HTTP narrative, up to 4 next actions), Data Quality panel updates (DQ Now vs Range lanes, TELEMETRY MISSING language), Metrics Evidence panel (replaces SCRAPING jargon), Navigation bus updates (Panel ID 1000).

pages.title: Alerting
pages.purpose: Documents Prometheus alert rules, recording rules, and alert routing.

pages.title: Observability Skills
pages.purpose: Documents Devin skills for dashboard and Prometheus management: observability-dashboard, observability-prometheus, and related Grafana/Prometheus skills.
page_notes: Available skills (2026-08): grafana-dashboard-render (rendering, preflight, auditing), grafana-dashboard-extension (editing, validating), prometheus-metric-discovery (real metrics discovery), prometheus-query-debugger (PromQL debugging), prometheus-alert-rule-editor (alert rule tuning), prometheus-rule-testing (promtool validation).
